review:
A classic 100-line slot that swaps fruit for crypto coins. Under the theme it's a very familiar layout: wilds, scatters and lots of lines.

Expanding wilds can fill whole reels and complete wins across loads of lines at once, and there's an optional card gamble after base-game wins. No complicated bonus round – the action is all line hits and expanding wilds. Medium-high volatility, a 3,000x cap and a high 97.1% RTP. Simple, modern-looking, no fuss.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
